title: Employ staff under the Salt Industry Award 2020
what: Pay and employ staff at no less than the terms of the Salt Industry Award 2020.

sources.title: Salt Industry Award 2020
sources.quote: 4.1 This industry award covers employers throughout Australia in the salt industry and their employees in the classifications listed in Schedule A —Classification Definitions to the exclusion of any other modern award.

reach.note: National system employers that are companies, in every state.

sources.title: Salt Industry Award 2020
sources.quote: 4.2 Definition of salt industry For the purpose of clause 4.2 , salt industry means: (a) the producing, gathering, extracting, harvesting, storing, distributing, packaging, manufacturing

sources.title: Salt Industry Award 2020
sources.quote: 4.2 Definition of salt industry For the purpose of clause 4.2 , salt industry means: (a) the producing, gathering, extracting, harvesting, storing, distributing, packaging, manufacturing, treating, refining, brine handling, processing and transporting, shipping and conveying of salt and incidental related work by employees of the employer; (b) the servicing, maintaining (including mechanical, electrical, fabricating or engineering) or repairing of plant and equipment or camp facilities used in the activities set out in clause 4.2(a) by employees employed by employers principally engaged in the salt industry; and (c) the provision of temporary labour services used in the activities set out in clauses 4.2(a) and 4.2(b) , by temporary labour personnel principally engaged to perform work at a location where the activities described in clauses 4.2(a) and 4.2(b) are being performed.

reach.note: Unincorporated employers outside WA (in WA they are in the state system).

sources.title: Which system of employment laws applies
sources.publisher: Government of Western Australia (Private Sector Labour Relations)
sources.quote: The state system covers: Private sector businesses and their employees that operate as: Sole traders. Partnerships, where none of the partners in the business is a constitutional corporation (trading or financial corporation).

assessment.summary: The Salt Industry Award sets the industry's classifications, minimum pay, allowances and penalty rates on top of the National Employment Standards.

marks.reason: Classifications, allowances, penalty rates and their record-keeping add to the cost and complexity of employing in the industry.
